product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series 3x1 TV Wall Mount for Portrait Display Menu Boards Fits 32 to 65 TVs with Adjustable Tilt
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series 3×1 TV Wall Mount for Portrait Display Menu Boards, Fits 32" to 65" TVs with Adjustable TiltThe Monoprice Commercial Series 3×1 TV Wall Mount is designed for professional menu board and digital signage installations using three portrait-oriented displays mounted directly to the wall. It supports 32" to 65" TVs, provides adjustable tilt for improved readability, and delivers a compact, low-profile alternative to ceiling-mounted menu board systems. This mount is ideal for locations where ceiling mounting is not feasible and a clean, wall-mounted vertical menu layout is preferred.Supports three portrait-oriented displays in a vertical wall layout without ceiling penetrationsFits 32" to 65" TVs for versatile commercial menu board applicationsAdjustable tilt from ‑6° to +15° for optimized viewing angles based on mounting height and viewer distanceWall-mounted design eliminates ceiling drops for a clean, low-profile installationSupports 90° portrait orientation for secure vertical display alignmentWall-mounted rail system maintains consistent spacing and alignment across all three screensSteel construction with wall anchors and lag bolts for permanent, professional installationIdeal for locations with low ceilings or architectural constraints where ceiling mounts are not practical THREE PORTRAIT DISPLAYS IN A VERTICAL WALL LAYOUTThe mount is engineered for a 3×1 portrait configuration, stacking three displays in a single vertical column using a wall-mounted rail system. This configuration eliminates ceiling drops while maintaining consistent spacing and alignment across screens. ADJUSTABLE TILT FOR IMPROVED READABILITYEach display interface supports fixed tilt positions up to 15°, allowing installers to optimise viewing angles based on mounting height and viewer distance. WALL MOUNTED DESIGN FOR LOW PROFILE INSTALLATIONSUnlike ceiling-mounted menu board systems, this model mounts directly to a load-bearing wall using lag bolts and anchors. The wall mount design reduces visual clutter and simplifies installation in spaces with low ceilings or architectural constraints. PORTRAIT ORIENTATION SUPPORTThe mount supports 90° portrait orientation, ensuring secure alignment for vertically mounted displays commonly used in menu boards and information displays. COMMERCIAL GRADE STEEL CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction with included wall mounting hardware supports secure, long-term installation.
